design: P5.14-L — capacity ladder on the failing configuration
status: FROZEN — written and hashed before any rung runs
purpose: Separate the two explanations the D1 report refused to choose between, and produce the number the project needs: THE LARGEST PLAN THIS ORACLE CAN EVALUATE.
governing_fact_this_serves: The oracle cannot evaluate a plan large enough to exhibit the effect the paper claims. Every stabilization finding — Q well defined, ADMM converging, one local failure in 1,095 — was established where the storage is economically negligible. At the first capacity where it is not, the evaluation aborts before ADMM starts.

rungs.all_three_nodes: the initialization solves all networks and all three ESSO subproblems, so all three nodes are reported at the same cost as node 7 alone

method.stop_point: the initialization block is replicated verbatim (create_admm_variables -> create_distribution_networks_models -> create_transmission_network_model -> create_shared_energy_storage_model, shared_resources_planning.py:2100-2112) and the run STOPS there. ADMM is never started.
method.configuration: identical to D1 cell 3: cold, rho_pf 300 adaptive, rel 1e-4, budget 5.0e6, C3 active
method.diagnostic_resolve: if a node's ESSO fails, that one model is re-solved directly with load_solutions=False and the .sol loaded manually, so that per-constraint residuals can be read AT THE TERMINAL POINT. Production leaves the model at its initial values after a failed solve, so this extra solve is necessary and is declared.

solve_profile.per_rung: 51 (36 DSO + 12 TSO + 3 ESSO) + at most 1 diagnostic re-solve per failing node
solve_profile.mode: armed and counted; any blocked solve fails the stage

primary_question.clean_threshold: solves at or below some capacity and fails above it, monotonically -> a FINDING ABOUT THE PLAN: that network cannot host that much storage, which is real engineering information
primary_question.erratic: non-monotonic or node-inconsistent failure -> a FINDING ABOUT THE TOOL
primary_question.either_way: the largest evaluable capacity is recorded

prime_suspect_predeclared.why: it has NO SLACK, unlike the cohort rows at :569 which carry slack_es_ch_comp_per_unit. It was identified as hard-infeasible rather than merely penalized during the throughput analysis (P5.13-A, site 2). A terminal violation of 6.84e-05 against a 1e-4 tolerance is consistent with it. At negligible capacity the normalized powers are tiny and the row never approaches binding; at 1.00 MVA it can.
prime_suspect_predeclared.test: report which constraint rows carry the terminal violation and whether the aggregate complementarity row is among them. That distinguishes a hard-row infeasibility from a diffuse numerical failure immediately.
prime_suspect_predeclared.falsification: if the violation is spread across many rows with no single dominant one, or the aggregate row is satisfied, the hypothesis is wrong and the failure is numerical

PREDECLARED GO/NO-GO.rule: once the largest evaluable capacity C* is known, compare the effect it can produce against the resolution. The bounded error bar at rel 1e-4 is twice the tolerance; the estimated bar is the sum of the two cells' terminal steps.
PREDECLARED GO/NO-GO.GO: if a plan at C* yields an effect comfortably above the bounded error bar, the campaign proceeds at that size and the paper's comparison is recoverable AT REDUCED SCALE — which must be stated as reduced scale, not as the paper's plan
PREDECLARED GO/NO-GO.NO_GO: if it does not, then THIS TOOL AS IT STANDS CANNOT DEMONSTRATE THE PAPER'S NUMERICAL CLAIMS. That conclusion goes to the manuscript rather than being treated as another blocker to clear.

not_permitted: reading a comparison from a rung
